This is the ultimate AI Benchmark test nobody asked for! Qwen 3.8 vs GLM 5.3 vs Kimi K3 vs Claude Opus 5 compete on a game of Monopoly. Who wins?

This experiment pits four artificial intelligence agents against each other in a classic board game setting. By enabling custom rules, the agents are forced to negotiate trades, manage bankruptcy, and adapt their tactics in real-time. This observation provides a clear look at how AI decision making evolves over the course of a long-form game, moving beyond simple programmed responses to show negotiation styles.
